description: Resolves the certified Reader family and version and returns default-filled canonical decode options. Validates options only; it does not acquire or decode bytes. Returns family_id, family_version, decode_options and decode_options_json for the recipe. Also returns reader_capabilities: available with certified same-family coordinates, output_format and accepted_media_types from this deployment, or unavailable when registry evidence cannot be read. Use available metadata to diagnose MEDIA_TYPE and choose a compatible certified pin; unavailable is not evidence of unsupported media. A different version can require different options and output columns; normalize it deliberately before registering a revision.
name: normalize_reader_options
title: Normalize Reader options
